label: Functional (No Buttonhole)

profile.distinguishingDetail: Functional with no buttonhole means the sleeve vent is cut and constructed as a true working opening — with the full placket, lining, and turnback construction of a bespoke cuff — but without the hand-worked buttonholes being cut through. The vent can be opened to roll the sleeve, secured when closed by a single interior snap or small hook. This option provides the structural honesty of a true vent while remaining easily alterable, a practical choice for clients who want bespoke character without the length-fixing consequences of open buttonholes.
